description: The chart is a nested pie chart comparing the distribution of two related variables, with the inner ring representing "Max Ambiguity" and the outer ring representing a standard deviation (Std) measure. The chart is divided into 8 slices, with 4 categories in each ring. The inner ring has three categories: "Max: 1" (lightest blue, 39.0%), "Max: 2" (medium blue, 38.0%), and "Max: 3" (darkest blue, 14.2% and 7.0% combined, but the 7.0% is part of the outer ring). The outer ring has four categories: "Std: 0.0" (dark blue, 49.0%), "Std: 0.47" (blue, 47.7%), "Std: 0.82" (lighter blue, 5.0%), and a small slice corresponding to "Std: 0.94" or "Max: 3" (light blue, 7.0% but not directly labeled on the inner ring). The chart includes a legend for both rings, with the inner ring labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)" and the outer ring labeled "(Outer)". Percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and the chart does not visually emphasize any particular slice. The slices are not ordered in a specific size-related pattern.
